About The Function:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who use exceptional research and analytical skills to create frame-breaking insights, market predictions and smart how-to guidance for a broad range of world-leading organizations. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day via consultative virtual and in-person meetings, sales support interactions and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and recommended actions.

The Role:

We’re looking for a forward-thinking Finance AI Expert to join the Gartner Finance Practice at the Senior Principal level.

As a Finance AI Expert you will regularly meet with Finance leaders such as CFOs, FP&A leaders, Controllers, Finance Transformation leaders and their teams to advise on their finance AI-related challenges and questions. If you’ve spent a good part of your career working in financial planning, finance analytics and have exposure to how companies are getting the most from investments in advanced analytics and AI/ML tools, then this expert role is for you.

The successful candidate will be comfortable discussing and researching topics including:
• Finance AI use cases
• Finance experience with advanced analytics tools
• Finance AI governance strategies
• Finance AI technology developments
• Finance AI pilots and approaches to scaling AI impact

Additional career exposure to forecasting, planning, budgeting, consolidation, data & analytics and business partnership beyond the Finance function (e.g., CIO, CDO, CDAO) will be highly valuable.

What you’ll do / Key Responsibilities :
• Create unique, defensible and consumable “must-have research” content that directly addresses the AI priorities and opportunities of finance leaders.
• Serve as a leading authority on finance AI and advanced analytics topics, such as: understanding Finance AI use cases; setting up AI pilots and scaling AI initiatives; ensuring proper governance of finance AI tools; navigating the Finance AI technology landscape; connecting AI to day-to-day finance process improvement and wholesale finance transformation.
• Stay abreast of broader research and trends in finance artificial intelligence.
• Provide current and prospective clients with actionable advice via virtual and face-to-face interactions.
• Support business growth and client engagement strategies by partnering with Gartner’s commercial organization to create long-term value for both clients and Gartner.
• Act as an internal advisor on how AI practices, technologies and approaches are impacting the finance function.
• Create and deliver presentation materials for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings.
• Build your personal brand as a functional expert to drive Gartner’s research, methodology and strategy.

What you’ll need:
• 10+ years’ experience with Finance AI topics or working in finance or general D&A teams with increasing scope and responsibility.
• Exposure to major finance processes, data sources, technologies and workflows.
• Experience with the deployment of advanced analytics capabilities to support short-, mid- or long-term decision making.
• Exposure to advanced analytics tools and approaches via on-the-job experience or formalized education (backgrounds in math, statistics, and physics a plus).
• Exposure to using AI/ML in forecasting, or experience with quantitative analytics, statistics and coding languages (preferably Python) a bonus.
• Moderate willingness to travel; though primarily a virtual role, Analysts occasionally have opportunities for domestic and international travel.

Who you are:
• Collaborative: extremely comfortable connecting, coordinating and delivering impact with global colleagues and clients in both virtual and face-to-face settings
• Organized: skilled at multitasking, prioritizing, and working under deadlines across various project types
• Confident: able to make sound decisions on projects and drive for results with minimal supervision (i.e., in a remote, virtual-first environment)
• Analytically savvy: able to flex strong critical reasoning skills and analytical capabilities to understand drivers of challenges and propose solutions
• Naturally curious: a life-long learner with an enthusiasm for exchanging ideas with others

job_description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Solutions Architect to join the Orlando, FL team and provide technical leadership and for delivering innovative solutions, products, and services in support of artificial intelligence (AI) enhanced modeling and simulation systems/solutions. This position reports to the Modeling, Simulation and Training (MS&T) Portfolio Manager in Orlando, FL. Candidate will have current knowledge and hands on experience with advanced technologies including generative AI, large language models (LLM) and synthetic behavior modeling that support simulation technologies, innovative solution designs within the modeling and simulation industry and is viewed as a subject matter expert by peers within and outside the organization.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Leads the development of MS&T concepts and capabilities to be incorporated into simulation solutions and offerings applicable across defense operational domains with initial emphasis on AI support to behavior generation, training support/development, sensor feed integration, and high-fidelity terrain integration, with further customer initiatives to achieve Army, Navy and broad DoD objectives. A key focus prioritizes MS&T functionality to be developed via both internal and customer funded research efforts, consistent with emerging DoD AI initiatives. Long-term emphasis is on scaled, distributed software-based simulation solutions applied in both training and operational scenarios.
• Assists in vision development to defined solutions fusing Leidos’ and partners’ C2, MS&T, and related (e.g. Trusted AI/ML) capabilities that advance Leidos’ ability to anticipate and deliver DoD-wide MDO initiatives into practical operational solutions.
• Represents Decision Advantage Solutions (DAS) in enterprise-wide efforts aligned with the role, to ensure that MS&T is incorporated into Leidos’ AI Accelerator approach and how MS&T enables AI enhanced CI/CD software development models for complex operational systems.
• Works to secure cross-organization buy-in on solutions that move from current practices toward agreement/acceptance of new concepts, practices, and approaches.
• Works with technical staff and business development personnel to understand customer needs; leads development of solutions that impact strategic project/program goals and business results.
• Performs technical execution leadership and development on a combination of customer and internally funded programs and research projects.
• Aligns solutions to the technical investment vision of the MDS Division and Decision Advantage Solutions under the direction of the operations CTO.
• Works to secure cross-organization buy-in for solutions that move from current practices toward agreement/acceptance of new concepts, practices, and approaches.

Basic Qualifications:
• Master of Science degree in computer engineering or similar degree with 20+ years of prior relevant experience.
• A broad understanding of MS&T and C2 technology, current and emerging artificial intelligence methodologies, with focus on application to synthetic training related to MDO/JADC2 initiatives, including classified systems and customers.
• Recent leadership experience in DoD customer facing organization(s) where the role directly influenced the direction of AI in support of synthetic training environments and constructs.
• Well published authorship of papers and briefings demonstrating thought leadership, as well as supporting various collaborative efforts through customer interaction.
• Extensive background in research and delivery of AI-based, natural language processing and intelligent agents for Computer Generated Forces simulation & training projects and programs.
• Strong communication skills.
• US Citizenship is required. Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation, must possess a Secret clearance and meet eligibility requirements for a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:
• PhD in computer engineering with 20 years of prior relevant experience.
• Recent experience in architecting MS&T solutions, with emphasis on emerging artificial intelligence simulation and training environments applicable to MDO/JADC2 DoD environments.
• Recent experience with software architectures, frameworks and SecDevOps practices.
• Recent experience with Orlando key customers / programs is highly preferred, e.g. service MS&T organizations.
• Experience leading the development of artificial intelligence supported training solutions for major capture and proposal efforts, balancing these solutions against cost, schedule, function, quality, and other business considerations.
• Direct experience working with relevant DoD user and acquisition organizations.
• Experience in support of and participation in transition of programs from capture/proposal to execution.
• Experience engaging in business development and capture efforts in the role of Solution Architect.

Generative AI is quickly changing how humans and computers interact and will have a drastic and lasting impact on the productivity of humankind. Come build with us, and let's usher in the age of generative AI together!
